flags.reason: The Segmented Control guide (3f56271) never says when to use Tabs instead, and the Tabs guide doesn't name Segmented Control. This rule's pointer to Tabs rests on the unpublished upstream SegmentedControl.mdx as the evidence records it (“prefer Tabs for peer views”); at dbe0e02f the mdx still says the control “filters or switches a value in place” while Tabs “switch peer views or pages” (lines 24 and 84). But the guide's own Three options card calls “a period or a view with three choices” the usual case, and the Tabs guide offers Tabs “to switch between a few peer views of the same content”, so from the published guides alone a designer or agent can't tell whether switching views belongs to this control or to Tabs. The guide should say when to use Tabs instead (and, as the mdx does, Segmented Track for a share-of chart and Chip Select for optional filters, which /avoidWhen/3 and /avoidWhen/4 also take from the mdx); then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r26, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #557.

examples.purpose: Three options, the guide's Three options card: a period with Daily, Weekly and Monthly. Weekly starts selected (defaultSelectedKey), as in the guide's code for that card. The keys stand for the screen's period values; left uncontrolled, the control moves its own selection when people tap.
examples.jsx:
<SegmentedControl
  items={[
    { key: 'daily', label: 'Daily' },
    { key: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly' },
    { key: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
  ]}
  defaultSelectedKey="weekly"
/>

from.quote: The usual case: a period or a view with three choices.

examples.purpose: Five options, the most that fits, the guide's Five options card: the ranges 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y and All, each key the same as its label. 1Y starts selected (defaultSelectedKey), as in the guide's code for that card. On a 360 px phone each segment is about 59 px.
examples.jsx:
<SegmentedControl

    { key: '1Y', label: '1Y' },
    { key: 'All', label: 'All' },

/>

from.quote: Five is the most that fits: on a 360 px phone each segment is about 59 px.

examples.purpose: Switching a portfolio's period, the guide's In context, showing the weekly change: a Card titled “Portfolio value” with the control above the change it controls, “+₹3,020 (2.4%) this week”. selectedKey="weekly" stands for the period the screen keeps, and onSelectionChange for the screen storing the new period and updating the change below. Between the control and the change the guide also shows the value, ₹ 1,24,560; in the guide's code it is a MoneyValue, which has no entry in this pack, so it is left out: report that the value needs MoneyValue.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <Card.Title>Portfolio value</Card.Title>
  <SegmentedControl
    items={[
      { key: 'daily', label: 'Daily' },
      { key: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly' },
      { key: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
    ]}
    selectedKey="weekly"
    onSelectionChange={() => {}}
  />
  <Text text="+₹3,020 (2.4%) this week" />
</Card>

from.quote: The screen keeps the selected period and updates the value below; the control only reports the tap.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to display as segments.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: Keys match by strict equality; a key that matches no item leaves every segment unselected. Declared: The currently selected key (controlled)

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: Read only at mount: a later change doesn't move the selection. Declared: The initially selected key (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first item's key.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Not called when the selected segment is pressed again. Declared: Callback fired when the selected segment changes.

props.name: style
props.description: In a row, an explicit style width wins over the width the labels need. Declared: Override container styles.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the tab list. Declared: Accessible name for the segment group.

props.name: SegmentedControlItem.key
props.description: A field of each items row.

props.name: SegmentedControlItem.label
props.description: A field of each items row.

modes.name: SegmentedControl/Segment
modes.description: Set by the control on each segment (Idle, or Active for the selected one), over the modes it is given. Declared: A token collection SegmentedControl reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: items
slots.description: A structured slot: an array of SegmentedControlItem rows. The items to display as segments

events.name: onSelectionChange
events.description: Callback fired when the selected segment changes
